notes: vMLX 1.6.35 — SSD-first prompt cache. The in-memory paged cache is now OFF by default and prompts are cached on your SSD, so memory use stays close to the model's own size (dots3-note peaked +3.0 GB over its 95 GB bundle at 48k tokens, with no idle drift). Turning the RAM tier back on buys about 2% on time-to-first-token and costs noticeably more memory; Session Settings now says so and points at the setting. The SSD budget is a percent of your disk (10% by default) instead of a flat gigabyte number, shared across every cache type and model, evicting the oldest prompts first. Stored prefix caches are full precision for every family. Fixes a case where the cache could be handed the entire disk while the interface reported a 10% cap, a DeepSeek-V4-Flash start failure on the new default, sessions whose model family was not recognised never receiving the new defaults, and a cache panel that reported success when the engine had declined to clear a tier still in use. Prompt caches survive a hard kill and restart across five cache architectures with 47 deterministic prompts byte-identical afterwards, image turns included. Both DMGs are Developer ID signed, notarized by Apple, and stapled.
